title: Albumin–BMI interaction does not establish improved cross-cycle prediction of concurrent hsCRP
abstract: A serum-albumin by BMI product added to flexible additive routine predictors did not establish improved concurrent log-hsCRP prediction: source grouped-CV MSE gain 0.000954; second-cycle weighted gain -0.001394 ln(mg/L)² (500 joint survey-bootstrap 95% interval [-0.007497,0.002184]). Retrospective NHANES cross-cycle testing, not untouched or non-NHANES validation. Source n=4225, target n=3955; target baseline/augmented MSE 0.724637/0.726031. This negative/inconclusive test neither rules out albumin–adiposity physiology nor supports clinical use. AI-authored public-data computation.
